entries.description: Authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis.
Read GAP #3 + GAP #5 + Gap A audits (audit + Pipeline.cs + UnresolvedItemAggregator).
Elaborated stub spec into full spec with locked Decisions 1-4 + Appendix A.
Landed 6 manifest envelope record types + DatabaseManifestAggregator + 13 unit tests.
dotnet build && dotnet test sequentially: build clean (warnings only); 1882 tests passed, 2 skipped (Access-COM-gated). 13 new DatabaseManifestAggregator tests included.
Cross-provider session-verification (round 1).
Cross-provider session-verification (round 2).
Cross-provider session-verification (round 3).
Cross-provider session-verification (round 4 — final spec consistency sweep).
Cross-provider session-verification (round 5 — final consistency sweep).
Authored Session 2 orchestrator recommendation via routed analysis.

Added AccessHarvester.Core -> AccessHarvester.Pipeline ProjectReference and wired Pipeline.Run() to emit manifest.json + unresolved-items.json via EmitManifestArtifacts after Enrich(). HarvesterVersion resolved from AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute. UnresolvedItems list built once, serialised twice. Disambiguated four AccessHarvester.Tests files (SyntheticDbIntegrationTests, SyntheticMetadataExtractorIntegrationTests, HomeHealthCareTableCoverageTests, SyntheticFixtureSnapshotTests) with `using CorePipeline = AccessHarvester.Core.Pipeline;` to resolve the namespace-vs-class collision the new ProjectReference introduced.

Updated tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Pipeline/EndToEndPipelineTests.cs to assert manifest.json + unresolved-items.json land alongside raw/kb/ir at <baseDir>. Top-level shape verified: SchemaType="DatabaseManifest", SchemaVersion="1.0", HarvesterVersion non-empty, Database.Name matches input. unresolved-items.json asserted as a JSON array.

Authored tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Pipeline/ManifestSchemaConformanceTests.cs closing Gap A from integration-testing-and-acceptance: hermetic [Fact] validates the aggregator-produced minimal manifest against harvester-schema.v1.0.json via SchemaValidator; [SkippableFact] drives Pipeline.Run() against MiniComplex.accdb and validates the produced manifest.json on disk.

dotnet build && dotnet test sequentially. Build: 314 warnings (existing CA1416 noise), 0 errors. Test: 1885 passed, 2 skipped (synthetic-DB fixtures missing on this host). All Integration tests (16) ran, including new ManifestSchemaConformanceTests and updated EndToEndPipelineTests.
Cross-provider session verification routed to gpt-5-4. Output persisted to session-002.md.

Tiebreaker (third opinion) routed to gemini-pro after R1 ISSUES_FOUND from gpt-5-4 (one Minor finding judged a context gap by the orchestrator). Human selected option (d) second-opinion per the workflow disagreement protocol.
Next-session orchestrator recommendation routed to gemini-pro.

Ran Pipeline.Default().Run(...) for HomeHealthCare.accdb and NorthwindDevEdition.accdb into tmp/golden-staging/. All categories extracted/translated/enriched cleanly (HHC 86 ok / 0 failed, NW 197 ok / 0 failed).

Re-ran pipeline against same fixtures into second staging dirs and diffed. Only field that drifted: manifest.json -> Database.ExportedAt. All per-object IR (7 categories on both fixtures) byte-identical; unresolved-items.json empty array on both.

Landed tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Pipeline/GoldenNormalizer.cs per Decision 4. Three entry points (NormalizeManifest, NormalizeUnresolvedItems, NormalizePerObjectIr). Manifest normalization replaces HarvesterVersion + Database.FilePath + Database.ExportedAt with placeholders; re-emits via JsonNode + same JsonSerializerOptions Pipeline.cs uses. Per-object IR is no-op (no observed drift).

Built one-shot tmp/build-golden-corpus/BuildGoldenCorpus.exe (gitignored) that links GoldenNormalizer.cs and produces samples/GoldenOutput/<fixture>/. Confirmed idempotency: builder invoked against second staging run yields byte-identical golden corpus.

Inspected golden corpus. Total 17MB (under 100MB stop-rule). HHC 175 files, NW 397 files. No empty files, no JSON parse errors. Sample inspections of Form/Table/Query/Module/Macro IR show well-formed output. Manifest per-category arrays empty as expected (V1 — collection threading is follow-on per Session 2 spec). No Stop Rule triggers.
dotnet build -c Release: 0 errors. dotnet test -c Release: 1885 passed, 2 skipped (synthetic-DB fixtures absent), 0 failed.
Cross-provider session-verification via gpt-5-4. Verdict: VERIFIED with 0 issues.
Routed Session 4 orchestrator recommendation via analysis (model=gemini-pro, cost=$0.0022).
